evals.name: run-note-formatter-evals
evals.prompt: Run evals on the note-formatter skill at ~/.claude/skills/skill-evals/evals/dummy-skill
evals.expected_output: A complete eval run: both with_skill and without_skill agents spawned, grading done, benchmark.json produced

assertions.name: parallel-agents-spawned
assertions.description: Transcript shows with_skill and without_skill agents were spawned in the same turn (not sequentially) for each eval case

assertions.name: tiered-grading
assertions.description: Transcript shows two graders were spawned per run — one structural (Haiku) and one nuanced (Sonnet) — and their results were merged into grading.json

assertions.name: benchmark-produced
assertions.description: Transcript shows aggregate_benchmark.py was run and produced benchmark.json and benchmark.md

assertions.name: eval-metadata-written
assertions.description: Transcript shows eval_metadata.json was written for each eval case before the runs completed

assertions.name: viewer-launched
assertions.description: Transcript shows the eval viewer (generate_review.py) was launched in the background
